_comment: "Turn ALL cards in ALL arsenals face-up. Then if there's a FACE-UP YELLOW card in ANY arsenal, create 2 Gold tokens." The flip was two APPLY_CONTINUOUS modifications of type TURN_ARSENAL_FACE_UP -- a type that exists nowhere in the engine. Stored as continuous-effect data rather than compiled, it never failed to load and never did anything, so the card's main clause was absent. The gate then asked for card_class "YELLOW": yellow is a COLOUR, no card has it as a class, so it matched nothing and the tokens could never be created either -- and its 'face_up' was a key CARD_IN_ZONE did not read. Both halves also looked only at the CONTROLLER's arsenal where the card says ANY. Go again was missing entirely.
